course.name: Document Processing
course.description: Extract and redact a small batch with evidence for each source.
course.longDescription: 35 minutes required. Prerequisite: Storage and Tables. Use supplied synthetic digital, scanned and mixed PDFs. An available vision model is needed for the scan exercise; model output is checked against fixture facts. Keep the documents in a scratch app and inspect every delivered copy. Scheduling and RAG indexing are separate courses.

modules.title: Build and check
modules.description: Complete the practical steps and inspect the result.

challenges.prompt: A shared Storage folder is named restricted. What access guarantee does that name provide?
challenges.explanation: None by itself; access depends on the actual storage/app permissions.

options.label: None by itself; access depends on the actual storage/app permissions.
It automatically makes every file private.
It prevents model nodes from reading its files.

challenges.prompt: A two-page PDF returns useful text for page 1 and empty content for page 2. What should the pipeline do?
challenges.explanation: Check and route page 2 separately, preserving page identity and reviewing its extracted facts.

options.label: Mark the whole document complete because its total text length is nonzero.
Delete the empty page from the original.
Check and route page 2 separately, preserving page identity and reviewing its extracted facts.

challenges.prompt: A summary says renewal is 60 days, while the source says 30. Which result is acceptable?
challenges.explanation: Correct or reject the summary using the source evidence before delivery.

options.label: Change the source record to match the summary.
Correct or reject the summary using the source evidence before delivery.
Trust the summary because it is shorter.

lessons.title: Inspect the exact copy you share

challenges.prompt: The mask reports two detections, but the signer name remains in the delivered copy. What should happen?
challenges.explanation: Hold or correct that copy and check derived outputs; the count is not sufficient evidence.

options.label: Hold or correct that copy and check derived outputs; the count is not sufficient evidence.
Publish because detection count is positive.
Log the full unmasked document as proof.

challenges.prompt: The record was written but the masked copy failed. When should the path enter the completed manifest?
challenges.explanation: After every required output succeeds or the documented recovery process resolves it.

options.label: Immediately after the first write.
Before extraction starts.
After every required output succeeds or the documented recovery process resolves it.

modules.title: Apply it
modules.description: Use the result to solve a new case.

challenges.prompt: Only the first page of a mixed document was indexed. What should recovery preserve?
challenges.explanation: Source/page identity, the missing-page work and a completion state that waits for all required pages.

options.label: A new unrelated source ID for every retry.
Source/page identity, the missing-page work and a completion state that waits for all required pages.
Only a green run status.

challenges.prompt: A summary was created before masking and still contains the signer’s name. What must be fixed?
challenges.explanation: Regenerate or redact the derived summary and inspect it before sharing.

options.label: Regenerate or redact the derived summary and inspect it before sharing.
Only mask the original file’s display name.
Hide the summary title.

challenges.prompt: A failed batch is rerun after two successful record writes. What prevents extra records?
challenges.explanation: Stable source IDs and upsert/recovery logic, with the manifest committed after required outcomes.

options.label: Random IDs and an unconditional Insert for each attempt.
A different folder name for every attempt.
Stable source IDs and upsert/recovery logic, with the manifest committed after required outcomes.
